basis: The dashboard shows May as the lowest output month at approximately 8,000-9,000 MWh, which is less than half the output of the next lowest month (Jun, ~17,500 MWh) and far below the other months (ranging from ~20,000 to 40,000 MWh). While no explicit numerical threshold is printed on the chart, the task requires deciding between a standard case and a critical anomaly. The magnitude of May's output relative to the rest of the dataset represents an exceptional isolation, which supports the interpretation of a critical anomaly rather than a standard low-output case. The 'background filing' option is unsupported as the task explicitly asks to choose between standard follow-up and critical escalation.
option_label: Escalate May to critical low-output anomaly review
